OPD with complaints of fever and ulcers on feet and\n hands since 5 days\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p2\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"s1\"\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cb\u003E HOPI:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"s1\"\u003EThe\n patient was apparently asymptomatic 5 days ago, then she\u0026nbsp; \ndeveloped fever which is\u0026nbsp; sudden in onset, continuous, low grade, not \nassociated with chills,rigors,\u003C\/span\u003Esweating, dizziness, fatigue and body pains, nausea, vomiting .\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"s1\"\u003ESecond\n day after onset of fever she went to her farm for work in the early \nmorning and injured her left great toe while harvesting\u0026nbsp; \u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"s1\"\u003EThird \nday she noticed progressive painful lesions appearing on both lower \nlimbs and upper limbs chest and neck . Not associated with loss of \nsensation, itching, joint pains.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p1\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: arial;\"\u003E\u003Cspan
